careers

If you want to join our workforce, please send your CV to:

Contact: jobs@holisticyber.com
 

HolistiCyber delivers elite cybersecurity services and technology to top-tier business organizations. Our founders have been leaders in developing counter cyber-terrorism solutions since before you bought your first flip phone. And while we can’t name-drop our clients publicly, many of them are companies with names you know.

What sets HolistiCyber apart from the competition is our team’s long history of hands-on experience defending against nation-state-grade cyber threats. With offices in New York, Tel Aviv and London, we serve large organizations around the world. We use proven, innovative methods to identify vulnerabilities and threats, assess cyber risks and recommend the best strategy for remediation. We are constantly improving our methods and we will expect the same of you.
